summary: Recon Technology, a China-based oilfield services and low-carbon energy company listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that on September 16, 2026 it received a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter confirming regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule. The company had been notified May 4, 2026 that its Class A ordinary shares traded below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a deficiency under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Nasdaq confirmed the closing bid price stayed at $1.00 or higher for ten consecutive business days, September 1 through September 15, 2026, and closed the matter. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated; this is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation, though a renewed sub-$1 print would restart the deficiency clock.
